question_text: What should I ensure when refilling with engine oil?

options.text: That I use engine oil that meets the vehicle manufacturer's specifications
That I do not exceed the maximum fill level
That I refill the engine oil while the engine is running

correct_answers.text: That I use engine oil that meets the vehicle manufacturer's specifications
That I do not exceed the maximum fill level

comment: Engine oil may only be used according to the specifications of the manufacturer. You are only allowed to refill the right oil. Make sure that you do not exceed the maximum permissible fill level, otherwise damage to the motor may occur. Never fill engine oil while the engine is running.

question_text: What is the function of engine oil in a combustion engine?
comment: Engine oil has different effects on an internal combustion engine. It is used for wear protection, cooling and cleaning. Make sure the engine oil level is sufficient.

question_text: How can you check the engine oil level?
comment: There is a sight glass where you can read the oil level. Otherwise, you can read it via an oil dipstick.

question_text: How can you check the engine oil level?
comment: Depending on the vehicle, the engine oil level can be checked in different ways. Modern vehicles can display the oil level in the infotainment system.

question_text: Why does the coolant have to be checked for sufficient frost protection before winter begins?

options.text: So the coolant does not freeze
So the cooling system is not damaged by frost
So the vehicle's operating permit does not lapse

correct_answers.text: So the coolant does not freeze
So the cooling system is not damaged by frost

comment: A freezing of the coolant (extends) to avoid you should adequately check the antifreeze. So you avoid even damage to the cooling system in case of frost. The operating license of the vehicle does not go out by it.

question_text: What are the functions of anti-freeze in the coolant system?

options.text: Anti-freeze protects the cooling system against freezing
Anti-freeze causes corrosion in the summer months

correct_answers.text: Anti-freeze protects the cooling system against freezing

comment: Antifreeze protect against corrosion (rust) and protect the cooling system from freezing. In the summer months, this is not the case.

question_text: Why do diesel and petrol engines need engine oil?

options.text: So pistons and bearings do not seize up

correct_answers.text: So pistons and bearings do not seize up

comment: Motor oil is needed in diesel and gasoline engines because it serves to reduce the internal friction and thus the piston and the bearing is not fixed run. The lubricating water pump is irrelevant.

question_text: What are the requirements of lubricating oils for diesel engines?

options.text: They have to be heat resistant
They have to be fluid during cold periods

correct_answers.text: They have to be heat resistant
They have to be fluid during cold periods

comment: Lubricating oils of diesel engines are used for heat resistance, fluidity in cold weather and wear reduction.
